title: Global Observability from Negative Gramian Curvature
statement: For the observed system $\dot{x}=f(x)$, $y=h(x)$ on an $n$-dimensional manifold, let $P(x_0)=\int_0^T\Phi(t)^TH(t)^TH(t)\Phi(t)\,dt$ be the local observability Gramian along the trajectory from $x_0$. If $P(x_0)$ is uniformly positive definite and bounded, does uniform negative curvature of the resulting Riemannian metric, together with geodesic completeness, imply global observability on $[0,T]$?
